CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISPICKVAL($User.TimeZoneSidKey, 'Europe/London'), EffectiveDate >= DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(EffectiveDate))) & "-03-21 00:00:00"), EffectiveDate < DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(EffectiveDate))) & "-10-27 00:00:00") ), EffectiveDate - (1/24), EffectiveDate )
CustomField.label: MTA Effective Date
